generic.Defined scope/population: All quote-and-buy eligibility gates and digital underwriting appetite parameters in the portal rule set.
generic.In-scope period: From the rule version effective date to the next scheduled digital appetite grid review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each gate carries age, state, prior-loss and risk-type values matching the approved appetite grid.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of published eligibility gates equals the count on the approved digital appetite grid.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rule version, effective date and the approval email attached to the portal change record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any gate deviating from the appetite grid logged with underwriting rationale and accept or revert decision.
generic.Test population: One in-appetite and one out-of-appetite test risk entered per product in the quote-and-buy journey.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Both test risks return the expected decision and no out-of-appetite risk receives a bindable quote.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-appetite risks route to the underwriter referral queue rather than being silently declined.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rule set active with version and effective date and no rule left in draft after publication.
generic.Evidence location: Portal admin console change record holding the rule version and the attached approval email.

steps.title: Retrieve the approved digital appetite grid for the rule build
sop: Obtain the current approved digital appetite grid and confirm its version and effective date.
List every product and state combination the quote-and-buy journey must support.
Confirm the grid approval is current and not superseded by a later underwriting instruction.
Done when the approved appetite grid version is identified and recorded for the build.
verify: Check the grid version referenced matches the latest approved underwriting appetite instruction.
Pass when the build references a current approved appetite grid version.

steps.title: Compare each eligibility gate in the Customer Self-Service Portal admin console
sop: Open the quote-and-buy rule set in the portal admin console.
Compare each eligibility gate for age, state, prior-loss and vehicle or property type against the grid.
Correct any gate that does not match and note the change made.
Done when every eligibility gate matches the approved digital appetite grid.
verify: Re-read each gate value in the console against the grid line it derives from.
Pass when no eligibility gate differs from the approved appetite grid.

steps.title: Set the referral-to-underwriter threshold in the portal rule set
sop: Set the referral threshold values that divert a risk to underwriter review.
Confirm the referral destination queue is live and monitored.
Confirm no rule path declines an out-of-appetite risk without offering referral.
Done when the referral threshold and destination queue are configured.
verify: Trace one borderline risk through the rule logic to the referral queue.
Pass when an out-of-appetite test quote reaches referral rather than a silent decline.

steps.title: Check the quote-to-bind step sequence against the approved journey map
sop: Walk the portal journey through quote, details, payment, e-sign and confirm.
Compare each step and its position against the approved journey map.
Confirm no disclosure screen is skipped, collapsed or shown after commitment.
Done when the live step sequence matches the approved journey map.
verify: Attempt to bypass a disclosure screen using browser back navigation.
Pass when the sequence matches the map and no disclosure screen can be skipped.

steps.title: Run in-appetite and out-of-appetite test risks through quote-and-buy
sop: Enter one in-appetite test risk and record the decision and premium returned.
Enter one out-of-appetite test risk and record whether it refers or declines.
Confirm the accepted quote carries through to the policy administration system correctly.
Done when both test outcomes are recorded against expected results.
verify: Compare each recorded outcome against the expected outcome from the appetite grid.
Pass when both test risks return the expected decision.

steps.title: Publish the rule version and attach approval to the portal change record
sop: Save the rule set with its version number and effective date.
Attach the approval email and the test outcome evidence to the change record.
Confirm no rule remains in draft or unapproved state after publication.
Done when the versioned rule set is published with approval evidence attached.
verify: Query the rule set status for any item still in draft after publication.
Pass when the rule set is active with version and effective date and nothing is left in draft.

generic.Defined scope/population: All self-service quoting and bind configuration changes requested for the release under coordination.
generic.In-scope period: From change request logging to the agreed deployment date for the release window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each change request states the affected journey step, business justification and business owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of deployed self-service changes equals the count of approved change requests.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change record holds the sign-off decision, approver name and the deployment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any change deployed outside the agreed window logged with reason and retrospective approval.
generic.Test population: Every self-service configuration change scheduled into the agreed release window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No configuration change deploys without a referenced change request and business sign-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Emergency changes route through expedited approval with the business owner recorded before deployment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Change request exists with a business owner, agreed release window and required test evidence listed.
generic.Evidence location: Change record in the CRM change queue linked to the portal configuration item.

steps.title: Log the self-service configuration change request in CRM
sop: Raise the change request naming the affected self-service journey step.
State the business justification and the customer or commercial outcome expected.
Name the business owner accountable for accepting the change.
Done when the change request is logged with step, justification and business owner.
verify: Open the logged request and check each mandatory field is populated.
Pass when the request carries affected step, justification and a named business owner.

steps.title: Agree the release window with IT against portal traffic profile
sop: Pull the hourly quote traffic profile from the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Propose a deployment window that avoids peak quote hours.
Confirm IT capacity and the rollback plan for that window.
Done when a release window is agreed and recorded on the change request.
verify: Compare the agreed window against the recorded peak traffic hours.
Pass when the agreed window falls outside peak quote traffic.

steps.title: Confirm the required test evidence is listed on the change record
sop: Review the change record for the test evidence required before sign-off.
Confirm the list covers the journey steps the change touches.
Add any missing evidence requirement before the build starts.
Done when the change record lists the full test evidence required for sign-off.
verify: Cross-check the listed evidence against the journey steps affected.
Pass when every affected journey step has a required test evidence item.

steps.title: Review the delivered change against the requested configuration
sop: Review the built configuration in the portal pre-production environment.
Compare behaviour against the change request description.
Raise any deviation back to IT before sign-off.
Done when the built change matches the request or deviations are raised.
verify: Walk the affected journey step and compare against the requested behaviour.
Pass when the built change matches the logged request.

steps.title: Record the business sign-off decision on the CRM change item
sop: Record the accept, reject or defer decision against the change item.
Name the approver and the date of the decision.
Attach the test evidence supporting the decision.
Done when the sign-off decision and approver are recorded on the change item.
verify: Check the change item for approver name, date and attached evidence.
Pass when a named business sign-off with evidence is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the deployment date and close the change coordination
sop: Confirm the deployment date with IT and record it on the change item.
Confirm no self-service change is scheduled without a referenced change request.
Notify the business owner of the scheduled deployment.
Done when the deployment date is recorded and communicated.
verify: List releases scheduled in the window and check each references a change request.
Pass when every scheduled self-service change references an approved change request.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every quote-to-bind funnel step in the digital channel journey being specified.
generic.In-scope period: From requirement drafting to recorded business sign-off of the requirement pack version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each funnel step states inputs, validation rules, error messaging and device behaviour.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of specified funnel steps equals the count of steps on the approved journey map.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Requirement pack version, author, date and the recorded business approval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any requirement deferred out of scope logged with rationale and target release.
generic.Test population: All numbered requirements in the quote-to-bind funnel specification.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Target conversion rate and maximum step count are stated as testable acceptance criteria.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved requirement conflicts escalate to the digital channel owner for decision before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Numbered funnel specification with acceptance criteria and recorded business owner sign-off.
generic.Evidence location: Requirement pack filed against the digital channel journey record in CRM.

steps.title: Map the current quote-to-bind funnel steps in the portal
sop: Walk the live Customer Self-Service Portal journey and list every quote-to-bind step.
Record the data captured and the decision taken at each step.
Note where the current journey diverges from the intended design.
Done when the current funnel steps are listed with their captured data.
verify: Compare the step list against a live journey walkthrough.
Pass when every live funnel step appears on the list.

steps.title: Document inputs, validation and error messaging per funnel step
sop: For each step record the required inputs and their formats.
Record the validation rule applied to each input.
Record the error message shown when validation fails.
Done when every funnel step has inputs, validation and error messaging documented.
verify: Check each documented step for the three required elements.
Pass when no funnel step is missing inputs, validation or error messaging.

steps.title: State target conversion and maximum step count as acceptance criteria
sop: Set the target quote-to-bind conversion rate for the journey.
Set the maximum number of steps permitted from quote start to bind.
Record both as numbered acceptance criteria in the requirement pack.
Done when conversion target and step ceiling are stated as acceptance criteria.
verify: Check the pack for a numeric conversion target and step ceiling.
Pass when both targets appear as testable acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Specify mobile, desktop and accessibility behaviour per step
sop: Describe mobile viewport behaviour for each funnel step separately from desktop.
State the accessibility requirement applying to each step including focus and contrast.
Confirm no requirement assumes desktop-only rendering.
Done when mobile, desktop and accessibility behaviour are specified per step.
verify: Read each step specification for separate mobile and accessibility statements.
Pass when every step covers mobile, desktop and accessibility behaviour.

steps.title: List required disclosure and consent screens and their funnel position
sop: List every disclosure and consent screen the journey must present.
State the exact funnel step at which each appears.
Confirm each appears before the customer commits rather than after.
Done when disclosure and consent screens are listed with their funnel positions.
verify: Check each listed disclosure has a stated position before commitment.
Pass when no required disclosure is positioned after the point of commitment.

steps.title: Circulate the requirement pack in CRM and record business sign-off
sop: Version the requirement pack and circulate it to the business owner.
Collect and resolve review comments before approval.
Record the approval decision, approver and date against the pack version.
Done when business sign-off is recorded on the requirement pack version.
verify: Open the pack record and check for approver name, date and version.
Pass when sign-off is recorded against a specific requirement pack version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every distinct drop-off and error point identified in the digital journey analysis for escalation.
generic.In-scope period: The analysis period covered by the funnel analytics extract supporting the escalation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each ticket carries funnel step, error code, affected volume and assigned severity.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of tickets raised equals the count of distinct drop-off and error points identified.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Funnel analytics extract attached to each ticket with its period and extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any identified point not escalated logged with the reason it was closed without a ticket.
generic.Test population: All drop-off and error points listed in the source funnel analysis.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No identified error point remains unlogged once the escalation is completed.
generic.Exception handling path: Points IT rejects as not reproducible return to analysis with the additional evidence requested.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: One ticket per point with quantified volume impact and an IT acknowledgement recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Escalation tracker entries linked to the IT tickets and the BI funnel extract.

steps.title: Extract the ranked drop-off and error list from the BI platform
sop: Pull the ranked drop-off and error analysis output from the BI reporting platform.
Confirm the extract states its period, filters and data source.
Confirm each entry is a distinct point rather than a duplicate of another.
Done when a de-duplicated ranked list of points is available for escalation.
verify: Check the extract for stated period and duplicate entries.
Pass when the list is de-duplicated and carries a stated period.

steps.title: Raise one IT ticket per distinct drop-off or error point
sop: Raise a separate ticket for each distinct point on the list.
State the funnel step, the portal error code and the affected quote volume.
Avoid bundling unrelated points into a single ticket.
Done when every distinct point has its own IT ticket raised.
verify: Reconcile the ticket count against the count of distinct points.
Pass when ticket count equals the distinct point count.

steps.title: Attach the funnel analytics extract to each ticket
sop: Attach the supporting extract showing the drop-off rate for that point.
State the period the extract covers on the ticket.
Include the query or report reference so IT can reproduce the figure.
Done when each ticket carries its supporting analytics extract.
verify: Open each ticket and check for an attached extract with a period.
Pass when no ticket lacks supporting analytics evidence.

steps.title: Assign severity from lost quotes per day and confirm with IT
sop: Calculate lost quotes per day for each point from the extract.
Assign severity using the agreed volume bands.
Confirm the assigned priority with IT and adjust if evidence changes it.
Done when every ticket carries an agreed severity.
verify: Compare assigned severity against the lost-quote volume band.
Pass when every ticket severity matches its quantified volume impact.

steps.title: Confirm each ticket references the reproducible underlying analysis
sop: Check each ticket names the report, filters and period used.
Confirm IT can reproduce the failure from what is recorded.
Supply any additional session or error detail IT requests.
Done when IT confirms each ticket is reproducible.
verify: Ask IT to reproduce one sampled ticket from the recorded detail.
Pass when the sampled failure is reproducible from the ticket alone.

steps.title: Record IT acknowledgement and target resolution date on the tracker
sop: Record the IT acknowledgement and named owner against each ticket.
Record the target resolution date agreed with IT.
Confirm no identified point remains unlogged or unacknowledged.
Done when acknowledgement and target dates are recorded for every ticket.
verify: Review the tracker for tickets without an owner or target date.
Pass when every escalated point has an IT owner and target resolution date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All digital lead capture sources and the CRM assignment rules routing their leads.
generic.In-scope period: From routing rule effective date to the next scheduled routing configuration review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each rule carries product, state, source, destination queue and the consent flag condition.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every product, state and source combination maps to a destination queue with no gaps.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing rule version and effective date recorded on the CRM configuration log.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Leads landing in the catch-all queue logged and reassigned with the routing gap noted.
generic.Test population: One test lead submitted per digital capture source into the CRM routing rules.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every test lead lands in its expected queue within the target routing SLA.
generic.Exception handling path: Leads without a consent flag are held from outbound routing and queued for consent review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Routing rules active with a default catch-all queue and no unassigned digital lead records.
generic.Evidence location: CRM lead assignment rule configuration log with version and test lead results.

steps.title: Build the routing matrix of product, state and source combinations
sop: List every product, state and digital source combination that can generate a lead.
Assign the intended destination queue for each combination.
Identify combinations with no defined owner and resolve them.
Done when every combination has an assigned destination queue.
verify: Scan the matrix for combinations with a blank destination.
Pass when no product, state and source combination lacks a queue.

steps.title: Configure the lead assignment rules in CRM
sop: Enter the assignment rules in CRM following the routing matrix.
Set the rule evaluation order so the most specific rule wins.
Confirm no two rules conflict on the same combination.
Done when the CRM assignment rules reflect the approved routing matrix.
verify: Compare the configured rules against the routing matrix line by line.
Pass when the configured rules match the matrix with no conflicts.

steps.title: Set the default catch-all queue in CRM
sop: Configure a catch-all queue that receives any lead matching no specific rule.
Assign a monitored owner to the catch-all queue.
Confirm lead creation cannot complete without an owner assigned.
Done when the catch-all queue is active with a monitored owner.
verify: Submit a lead with an unmapped source and observe where it lands.
Pass when the unmapped lead lands in the monitored catch-all queue.

steps.title: Confirm the capture-form consent flag writes to the CRM lead record
sop: Submit a capture form from the marketing automation platform with consent granted.
Confirm the consent flag and consent text version write to the CRM lead record.
Submit a form without consent and confirm outbound routing is blocked.
Done when consent presence and absence both behave as specified.
verify: Inspect both test lead records for the consent flag state and routing outcome.
Pass when a lead without consent is blocked from outbound routing.

steps.title: Submit one test lead per source and time the routing
sop: Submit a test lead from each live digital capture source.
Record the queue each lead reaches and the time taken.
Investigate any lead reaching an unexpected queue.
Done when every source has a recorded test result.
verify: Compare each recorded landing queue and elapsed time against the expected values.
Pass when every test lead reaches the expected queue within the target SLA.

steps.title: Record the routing rule version on the CRM configuration log
sop: Record the routing rule version, effective date and approver on the configuration log.
Attach the test lead results to the log entry.
Confirm no digital lead records remain unassigned after activation.
Done when the version is logged and the unassigned lead count is zero.
verify: Query CRM for digital leads with no owner after activation.
Pass when no unassigned digital lead record remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full scripted quote-to-bind test pack covering every funnel case on mobile and desktop.
generic.In-scope period: From UAT cycle start to recorded UAT sign-off against the tested build version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each test case records tester, device, build version and a pass or fail result.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of executed test cases equals the count of cases in the approved UAT pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: UAT sign-off holding tester name, date and the build version tested.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each defect logged with severity, owner and a fixed, deferred or accepted disposition.
generic.Test population: Every scripted quote-to-bind case executed on both mobile and desktop viewports.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No severity 1 or 2 funnel defect remains open at the point of UAT sign-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed cases are logged as defects, retested after fix and only then marked passed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Completed UAT pack with a pass or fail result recorded for every funnel test case.
generic.Evidence location: UAT pack and defect log filed against the release record for the tested build.

steps.title: Confirm the UAT pack and test environment build version
sop: Confirm the scripted quote-to-bind test pack covers every funnel step and product.
Record the portal build version deployed to the test environment.
Confirm the policy administration test instance is connected and available.
Done when the pack and the build version under test are confirmed.
verify: Check the recorded build version against the deployed environment.
Pass when the pack and the recorded build version match the environment.

steps.title: Execute the scripted test pack end to end on desktop
sop: Run each scripted case through quote to bind on the desktop viewport.
Record pass or fail per step with the observed behaviour on failure.
Capture screenshots for every failed step.
Done when every desktop case has a recorded result.
verify: Count cases with a recorded desktop result against the pack size.
Pass when every pack case has a desktop result recorded.

steps.title: Repeat the scripted test pack on the mobile viewport
sop: Run the same scripted cases on the mobile viewport.
Record pass or fail per step and note any layout or truncation issue.
Confirm disclosure text remains legible and complete on mobile.
Done when every mobile case has a recorded result.
verify: Count cases with a recorded mobile result against the pack size.
Pass when every pack case has a mobile result recorded.

steps.title: Reconcile quoted premium to bound premium in the policy admin system
sop: For each bound test case compare the quoted premium to the bound premium.
Compare the effective date and coverage limits between quote and policy record.
Log any difference as a defect with both values captured.
Done when premium and terms are compared for every bound test case.
verify: Recompute the comparison for a sample of bound test cases.
Pass when quoted premium equals bound premium for every test case.

steps.title: Test disclosure rendering and back-navigation bypass in the portal
sop: Confirm every disclosure and consent screen renders in the journey.
Attempt to bypass each using browser back and forward navigation.
Log any bypass or non-rendering as a severity 1 or 2 defect.
Done when every disclosure screen has been tested for bypass.
verify: Re-run the bypass attempt on each disclosure screen after any fix.
Pass when no disclosure screen can be bypassed by browser navigation.

steps.title: Record UAT sign-off with tester, date and build version
sop: Review the defect log and confirm no severity 1 or 2 defect is open.
Record the sign-off with tester name, date and build version.
File the completed pack and defect log against the release record.
Done when UAT sign-off is recorded against the tested build version.
verify: Query the defect log for open severity 1 or 2 items at sign-off.
Pass when no severity 1 or 2 defect is open at UAT sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: All step-level quote journey events for the digital funnel in the analysis period.
generic.In-scope period: The stated analysis period for which journey events and portal error logs are extracted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each event carries session, funnel step, timestamp, device, product and traffic source.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quote starts in the event data reconcile to portal quote-start counts for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis output retained with data source, extract date, period and filters applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Steps with missing or malformed event data logged and excluded with the reason stated.
generic.Test population: All funnel steps in the quote journey for the analysed period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Error-driven drop-offs are separated from behavioural abandonment in the output.
generic.Exception handling path: Suspected tracking gaps are ruled out against portal counts before a behavioural cause is concluded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Drop-off rate produced by step, device and product with ranked top contributors.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform analysis output stored with its warehouse query reference.

steps.title: Extract step-level quote journey events from the data warehouse
sop: Query the enterprise data warehouse for step-level quote journey events for the period.
Confirm the event stream is complete with no missing load days.
Record the query, period and filters used for reproducibility.
Done when a complete step-level event extract exists for the period.
verify: Compare daily event counts across the period for gaps or spikes.
Pass when no load day is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Calculate the drop-off rate at each funnel step in the BI platform
sop: Build the step sequence and count sessions entering and leaving each step.
Calculate the drop-off rate at each step.
Reconcile quote starts against the portal reported quote-start count.
Done when a drop-off rate exists for every funnel step.
verify: Compare calculated quote starts against the portal source count.
Pass when the funnel entry count reconciles to the portal count.

steps.title: Segment drop-off by device, product and traffic source
sop: Break the funnel by device type, product and traffic source.
Identify the segments where drop-off concentrates.
Confirm segment volumes are large enough to be meaningful.
Done when drop-off is reported by device, product and source.
verify: Check segment totals sum back to the overall funnel totals.
Pass when segment breakdowns reconcile to the total funnel.

steps.title: Cross-reference portal error logs against drop-off sessions
sop: Join portal error log entries to the dropping sessions by session and timestamp.
Classify each drop-off as error-driven or behavioural abandonment.
Quantify the volume in each classification per step.
Done when every material drop-off point carries a classification.
verify: Sample dropped sessions and confirm the classification against the raw log.
Pass when error-driven and behavioural drop-offs are separately quantified.

steps.title: Rank drop-off points by lost quotes per day
sop: Convert each drop-off point to lost quotes per day.
Rank the points from highest to lowest volume impact.
Document the top contributors with their step and classification.
Done when a ranked list of drop-off points exists.
verify: Recompute the lost-quote figure for the top ranked point.
Pass when the ranking reflects the recomputed volume impact.

steps.title: Review the ranked list with the digital channel owner
sop: Present the ranked drop-off list with its classification and volumes.
Challenge any point where the evidence does not support the cause stated.
Confirm which points proceed to escalation.
Done when the ranked list is reviewed and escalation scope is agreed.
verify: Check the analysis output states data source, period and filters applied.
Pass when the reviewed output is reproducible from its stated source and filters.

generic.Defined scope/population: Portal uptime, daily sessions, quote starts, quote completions and bind rate for the digital channel.
generic.In-scope period: The monitoring period covered by the daily metric series being reviewed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each daily record carries uptime, sessions, quote starts, completions and binds.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Daily bind counts sum to the period bind total reported by the portal source.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Monitoring result recorded with reviewer name, date and dashboard refresh timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each metric outside tolerance logged with its suspected driver and follow-up action.
generic.Test population: Every day in the monitored period across the tracked digital channel metrics.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each metric sits inside its agreed tolerance band or is flagged with a driver.
generic.Exception handling path: Outage windows and feed gaps are recorded and excluded from baseline comparison with a note.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Period metrics recorded with baseline comparison and no unexplained gap in the daily series.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform monitoring record for the period with reviewer and date.

steps.title: Check portal uptime for the period against the availability target
sop: Pull the Customer Self-Service Portal availability record for the period.
Compare measured uptime against the availability target.
Note every outage window with its start, end and cause.
Done when uptime is compared to target and outages are noted.
verify: Cross-check noted outage windows against the incident record.
Pass when every outage in the period is recorded with its window.

steps.title: Refresh the digital channel metric series in the BI platform
sop: Confirm the dashboard refreshed on schedule for every day in the period.
Check for feed gaps or partial loads that would distort the series.
Record any gap and its effect on the affected metric.
Done when the daily series is refreshed and any gap is recorded.
verify: Scan the daily series for missing or zero-value days.
Pass when no unexplained gap exists in the daily metric series.

steps.title: Compare daily sessions, quote starts and completions to baseline
sop: Compare daily sessions, quote starts and quote completions against the agreed baseline.
Calculate the variance for each metric.
Highlight days where variance exceeds the tolerance band.
Done when every tracked volume metric is compared to baseline.
verify: Recompute variance for one sampled day against the baseline value.
Pass when the recomputed variance matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Compare bind rate against baseline and reconcile bind counts
sop: Calculate the period bind rate from completions and binds.
Compare it against the baseline bind rate.
Reconcile the bind count to the portal source before reporting.
Done when bind rate is compared and bind counts reconcile.
verify: Compare the reported bind count against the portal bind confirmations.
Pass when the reported bind count agrees with the portal source.

steps.title: Flag metrics outside tolerance and record the suspected driver
sop: List every metric sitting outside its tolerance band.
Record the suspected driver for each flagged metric.
Raise any driver requiring investigation to the analyst.
Done when every out-of-tolerance metric carries a suspected driver.
verify: Check each flagged metric for a recorded driver.
Pass when no flagged metric lacks a suspected driver.

steps.title: Record the period monitoring result with reviewer and date
sop: Record the period monitoring outcome including baseline comparison and flags.
Name the reviewer and the review date on the record.
File the record against the digital channel monitoring log.
Done when the monitoring result is filed with reviewer and date.
verify: Open the filed record and check for reviewer, date and variance flags.
Pass when the period record carries reviewer, date and baseline comparison.

generic.Defined scope/population: The journey content, field order and offer sequencing changes selected from the ranked drop-off analysis.
generic.In-scope period: From change deployment to the end of the stated conversion measurement window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each change records the target drop-off point, expected lift, portal version and measurement metric.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sessions in the measurement window reconcile between the portal and the BI conversion report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deployed portal version and the before and after conversion figures with their dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes that fail to deliver the expected lift logged with a keep, revise or revert decision.
generic.Test population: All sessions in the optimised journey step during the measurement window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Measured conversion movement is compared against the stated expected lift for each change.
generic.Exception handling path: Any change that degrades conversion or obscures a disclosure is reverted to the prior version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deployed change recorded with the conversion evidence that justified it and its measured result.
generic.Evidence location: Portal change record plus the BI conversion measurement report for the window.

steps.title: Select optimisation targets from the ranked drop-off analysis in BI
sop: Review the ranked drop-off analysis and pick the points with the largest recoverable volume.
State the expected conversion lift for each selected target and its assumption.
Confirm each target maps to a specific journey step that can be changed.
Done when the optimisation targets and expected lifts are stated.
verify: Trace each selected target back to a ranked drop-off finding.
Pass when every target derives from an evidenced drop-off point.

steps.title: Draft the content, field-order or offer-sequencing change
sop: Draft the specific wording, field order or offer sequence change for the target step.
Confirm the change addresses the evidenced cause rather than a preference.
Circulate the draft to the channel owner for agreement.
Done when the change content is drafted and agreed.
verify: Compare the drafted change against the drop-off cause it targets.
Pass when the drafted change addresses the evidenced cause.

steps.title: Check the change preserves required disclosures and price presentation
sop: Review the change against the list of required disclosures for that step.
Confirm no disclosure is removed, shrunk, delayed or moved behind an interaction.
Confirm the premium remains visible before any commitment action.
Done when disclosure and price presentation are confirmed intact.
verify: Walk the changed step and check each required disclosure and the price display.
Pass when no required disclosure or price element is removed or obscured.

steps.title: Deploy the change to the Customer Self-Service Portal and record the version
sop: Deploy the agreed change to the live portal journey step.
Record the deployed portal version and deployment timestamp.
Confirm the change renders correctly on mobile and desktop after deployment.
Done when the change is live and its version is recorded.

Record dependencies on IT, pricing or compliance.
Flag candidates blocked by an unresolved dependency.
Done when effort and dependency are recorded per candidate.
verify: Check each candidate for an effort estimate and dependency note.
Pass when no candidate lacks effort or dependency detail.

steps.title: Rank candidates by benefit against effort
sop: Rank candidates using benefit against effort.
Identify the shortlist worth taking to experimentation.
Record the ranking method applied.
Done when candidates are ranked and a shortlist is identified.
verify: Re-apply the ranking method to the candidate list.
Pass when the shortlist reproduces from the ranking method.

steps.title: Review the shortlist with the digital channel owner
sop: Present the ranked shortlist with benefit and effort.
Challenge benefit estimates not supported by the funnel evidence.
Record which candidates are accepted for testing.
Done when the shortlist is reviewed and acceptance is recorded.
verify: Check accepted candidates carry benefit and effort estimates.
Pass when every accepted candidate has both estimates.

steps.title: Document the opportunity list and file it
sop: Document the opportunity list with benefit, effort and source finding.
Version the list with author and date.
File it against the funnel analysis it derives from.
Done when the opportunity list is documented and filed.
verify: Retrieve the filed list and check benefit and effort per item.
Pass when every item carries quantified benefit and an effort estimate.

generic.Defined scope/population: The winning experiment variants being promoted into the live digital journey.
generic.In-scope period: From promotion decision to the end of the post-deployment monitoring window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each deployment records variant, primary metric result, version and deploy date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-deployment traffic to the winning experience equals total journey traffic.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deployment version and date with the significance evidence that justified promotion.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Post-deployment metric degradation logged with a hold, revise or revert decision.
generic.Test population: All journey steps affected by the promoted variant.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The variant reached statistical significance on the primary metric before promotion.
generic.Exception handling path: Regression failures or disclosure loss trigger an immediate revert to the prior version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Winning variant deployed to full traffic with the deployment version recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Portal deployment record with the BI experiment result and monitoring output.

steps.title: Confirm statistical significance on the primary metric
sop: Retrieve the experiment result for the variant.
Confirm significance was reached on the primary metric.
Hold promotion where the result is inconclusive.
Done when significance is confirmed before promotion.
verify: Check the recorded confidence interval and sample size.
Pass when the variant reached significance before promotion.

steps.title: Deploy the winning variant to full traffic in the portal
sop: Deploy the winning variant to 100 percent of traffic.
Record the deployment version and timestamp.
Confirm the variant renders on mobile and desktop.
Done when the variant is live to full traffic.
verify: Load the live journey step on both viewports.
Pass when the winning variant serves to all traffic.

steps.title: Retire the test split configuration
sop: Disable the experiment split for the promoted test.
Confirm no traffic is still routed to the losing variant.
Archive the experiment configuration.
Done when the test split is retired.
verify: Check the routing configuration for residual split traffic.
Pass when no residual test split routes traffic.

steps.title: Regression test the affected journey steps
sop: Run the regression pack across the affected journey steps.
Confirm quote, price and disclosure behaviour are unchanged.
Log any regression as a blocking defect.
Done when regression testing is complete with no blocking defect.
verify: Compare quote and price behaviour before and after deployment.
Pass when quote, price and disclosure behaviour are unchanged.

steps.title: Confirm required disclosures and no dark-pattern elements
sop: Check every required disclosure survives in the deployed experience.
Check no default-on election or pressure element was introduced.
Revert immediately if either check fails.
Done when disclosures and pattern integrity are confirmed.
verify: Walk the deployed journey and inspect election defaults and disclosures.
Pass when all required disclosures remain and no dark pattern is present.

steps.title: Monitor the primary metric post-deployment
sop: Monitor the primary metric across the agreed post-deployment window.
Compare realised movement against the experiment result.
Record a keep, revise or revert decision at window end.
Done when the monitoring window closes with a recorded decision.
verify: Compare post-deployment metric against the experiment lift.
Pass when the deployment version and monitoring result are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: All proposed channel optimisation experiments considered for the plan.
generic.In-scope period: The planning horizon the prioritised experiment plan covers.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each experiment states hypothesis, primary metric, minimum detectable effect and sample.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled experiment traffic requirements fit within available channel volume.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved plan version with author, approval date and scheduling window.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Experiments deferred for insufficient volume logged with the revisit condition.
generic.Test population: Every experiment proposed for the planning horizon.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each experiment has a calculated sample sufficient to reach significance.
generic.Exception handling path: Experiments that cannot reach significance are redesigned or dropped from the plan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved plan with hypothesis, primary metric and required sample per experiment.
generic.Evidence location: Experiment plan filed in BI with the portal journey step scheduling map.

steps.title: Write hypothesis, primary metric and effect size per experiment
sop: Write a testable hypothesis for each proposed experiment.
Name the single primary metric.
State the minimum detectable effect worth acting on.
Done when every experiment has hypothesis, metric and effect size.
verify: Check each experiment for one named primary metric.
Pass when no experiment has more than one primary metric.

steps.title: Calculate the traffic and duration needed for significance
sop: Calculate the sample needed for the stated effect size.
Convert to duration using the available traffic on that journey step.
Flag experiments where volume is insufficient.
Done when required sample and duration are calculated per experiment.
verify: Recompute the sample requirement for a sampled experiment.
Pass when the required sample is achievable within the planned duration.

steps.title: Score experiments on impact, confidence and effort
sop: Score each experiment on expected impact, confidence and effort.
Record the evidence behind the impact score.
Rank the experiments from the scores.
Done when every experiment is scored and ranked.
verify: Check each impact score for supporting evidence.
Pass when every impact score has supporting evidence.

steps.title: Sequence experiments to avoid confounding overlap
sop: Map each experiment to the journey step it changes.
Sequence so no two concurrent experiments touch the same step.
Adjust the schedule where overlap is unavoidable.
Done when the schedule avoids overlapping journey steps.
verify: Check the schedule for concurrent experiments on the same step.
Pass when no two concurrent experiments target the same funnel step.

steps.title: Confirm measurement and tracking readiness per experiment
sop: Confirm the primary metric is measurable at the required grain.
Confirm the tracking exists on the affected journey step.
Raise any tracking gap before scheduling.
Done when measurement readiness is confirmed per experiment.
verify: Test the metric capture on the target journey step.
Pass when the primary metric is measurable before the experiment starts.

steps.title: Obtain channel owner approval of the prioritised plan
sop: Present the prioritised experiment plan.
Record the approval decision and date.
File the approved plan version.
Done when the prioritised plan is approved and filed.
verify: Retrieve the approved plan and check hypothesis, metric and sample per experiment.
Pass when every experiment carries all three elements.

generic.Defined scope/population: Period KPI performance plus every optimisation deployed in the digital channel.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period covered by the performance and optimisation report.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each KPI carries actual, target, variance and commentary where off target.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report figures reconcile to the certified digital channel dashboard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report version with period, issue date and recorded decisions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Optimisations that missed their expected benefit logged with the action taken.
generic.Test population: All KPI metrics and all optimisations deployed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Realised benefit is reported for every optimisation deployed in the period.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled figures hold the report from issue until the difference is explained.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Issued report including optimisation outcomes against expected benefit.
generic.Evidence location: Issued report archived with the certified BI dashboard and warehouse extract.

steps.title: Report period performance against the KPI framework
sop: Compile each KPI actual against its framework target.
Calculate variance and apply the tolerance bands.
Write commentary for each variance beyond tolerance.
Done when KPI performance and commentary are compiled.
verify: Check every off-target KPI carries commentary.
Pass when no off-target KPI lacks commentary.

steps.title: List optimisations deployed in the period
sop: List every optimisation deployed in the period.
Record its expected benefit at deployment.
Confirm the list matches the portal deployment history.
Done when every deployed optimisation is listed.
verify: Compare the list against the portal deployment history.
Pass when every deployed optimisation appears on the list.

steps.title: Report realised versus forecast conversion lift
sop: Measure the realised lift for each deployed optimisation.
Compare against the forecast benefit.
Note where the benefit did not materialise and why.
Done when realised versus forecast lift is reported per optimisation.
verify: Recompute one realised lift from the warehouse data.
Pass when realised benefit is reported for every optimisation.

steps.title: Reconcile the figures to the certified dashboard
sop: Compare report figures against the certified dashboard.
Resolve any difference before issue.
Record the reconciliation on the working file.
Done when report figures reconcile to the certified dashboard.
verify: Recompare report and dashboard figures after resolution.
Pass when report figures agree with the certified dashboard.

steps.title: Present the report to distribution leadership
sop: Present KPI performance and optimisation outcomes.
Explain where forecast benefits did not materialise.
Capture challenge and requests for further analysis.
Done when the report is presented and challenge is captured.
verify: Check the presented version matches the reconciled report.
Pass when the presented version is the reconciled version.

steps.title: Record decisions and actions agreed
sop: Record the decisions taken at the review.
Assign owners and due dates to each action.
Archive the issued report with the decisions recorded.
Done when decisions and actions are recorded and archived.
verify: Retrieve the archived report and check optimisation outcomes and actions.
Pass when the archived report includes optimisation outcomes against expected benefit.

generic.Defined scope/population: Digital marketing spend by campaign and channel for the efficiency review period.
generic.In-scope period: The review period covering spend, leads, quotes and bound policies.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each campaign carries spend, leads, quotes, binds and the attribution basis.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Campaign spend sums to the finance source total for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review output with spend source, attribution model and review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Campaigns above the acquisition-cost threshold logged with the decision taken.
generic.Test population: Every campaign and channel with spend in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The attribution model is stated and applied consistently across compared channels.
generic.Exception handling path: Campaigns exceeding the cost threshold are paused or reallocated with the owner decision recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review showing cost per bound policy by campaign and channel for the period.
generic.Evidence location: BI spend efficiency output with the marketing platform spend and finance reconciliation.

steps.title: Compile digital marketing spend by campaign and channel
sop: Compile spend by campaign and channel from the marketing platform.
Reconcile the total against the finance source.
Record the spend source and extract date.
Done when spend is compiled and reconciled to finance.
verify: Compare compiled spend against the finance total.
Pass when campaign spend sums to the finance source total.

steps.title: Calculate cost per lead, quote and bound policy
sop: Calculate cost per lead, per quote and per bound policy per campaign.
Apply the same period basis to spend and outcomes.
Record the counts behind each ratio.
Done when the three cost ratios are calculated per campaign.
verify: Recompute one cost per bound policy from spend and binds.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the reported figure.

steps.title: State and apply the attribution model consistently
sop: State the attribution model used for the review.
Apply it identically across every channel compared.
Note where a channel cannot support the model.
Done when the attribution model is stated and applied.
verify: Check attribution treatment across the compared channels.
Pass when the attribution model is applied consistently.

steps.title: Identify campaigns above the acquisition-cost threshold
sop: Compare each campaign against the acquisition-cost threshold.
List those above threshold and quantify the spend at risk.
Note whether volume justifies continued spend.
Done when above-threshold campaigns and spend at risk are identified.
verify: Recompute the spend at risk for the listed campaigns.
Pass when the spend at risk matches the campaign spend detail.

steps.title: Recommend reallocation of inefficient spend
sop: Recommend pausing or reallocating spend on inefficient campaigns.
State the expected effect of each reallocation.
Identify the campaigns receiving the reallocated spend.
Done when reallocation recommendations are made.
verify: Check each recommendation against the campaign cost evidence.
Pass when every recommendation is supported by cost evidence.

steps.title: Record the decision with the spend owner
sop: Review the recommendations with the spend owner.
Record accept, defer or reject per recommendation.
File the review output with the decisions recorded.
Done when decisions are recorded against every recommendation.
verify: Retrieve the filed review and check cost per bound policy by campaign.
Pass when the review shows cost per bound policy by campaign and channel.

generic.Defined scope/population: Control and variant sessions in the digital journey A/B test being read.
generic.In-scope period: From test start to the pre-set sample size or duration being reached.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each test record carries sample, split, lift, confidence interval and guardrail metrics.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Control plus variant sessions equal total sessions entering the tested step.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Experiment log entry with figures, read date and analyst name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Tests invalidated by assignment leakage logged and marked for rerun.
generic.Test population: All sessions assigned to control or variant during the test.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No result is declared before the pre-set sample size or duration is reached.
generic.Exception handling path: Guardrail degradation blocks a win declaration until the cause is understood.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Experiment log entry with sample, lift, confidence interval and outcome.
generic.Evidence location: BI experiment log with the portal test configuration and session assignment data.

steps.title: Confirm the pre-set sample or duration is reached
sop: Compare the sample reached against the pre-set requirement.
Compare elapsed duration against the planned duration.
Hold the read where neither threshold is met.
Done when the pre-set sample or duration is confirmed reached.
verify: Check the recorded sample against the pre-set requirement.
Pass when no result is read before the pre-set threshold.

steps.title: Confirm the traffic split matches the intended allocation
sop: Compare actual control and variant session counts against the intended split.
Check for assignment leakage between arms.
Invalidate the test where leakage is material.
Done when the split and assignment integrity are confirmed.
verify: Recount sessions per arm from the session assignment data.
Pass when the actual split matches the intended allocation.

steps.title: Calculate lift and confidence interval on the primary metric
sop: Calculate the lift on the primary metric.
Calculate the confidence interval and significance.
Record the underlying counts behind the calculation.
Done when lift and confidence interval are calculated.
verify: Recompute the lift from the recorded counts.
Pass when the recomputed lift matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Check guardrail metrics have not degraded
sop: Check bind rate, average premium and complaint volume across both arms.
Flag any guardrail metric that degraded in the variant.
Hold a win declaration where a guardrail degraded.
Done when guardrail metrics are checked for both arms.
verify: Compare each guardrail metric between control and variant.
Pass when no guardrail metric degraded in the winning arm.

steps.title: Review the read with the digital channel owner
sop: Review the lift, confidence interval and guardrails.
Challenge any conclusion drawn from an underpowered read.
Agree the outcome classification.
Done when the read is reviewed and the outcome is agreed.
verify: Check the agreed outcome against the significance evidence.
Pass when the outcome classification matches the statistical evidence.

steps.title: Record win, loss or inconclusive in the experiment log
sop: Record the outcome as win, loss or inconclusive.
Record sample, lift, confidence interval and guardrail results.
File the entry against the portal test configuration.
Done when the experiment log entry is recorded.
verify: Retrieve the log entry and check sample, lift, interval and outcome.
Pass when the entry carries all four elements.
